summary: Iter 87 tested: 3 admin reports (artist-bookings, manager-leads, platform-waivers) with JSON+CSV, unified audit log with filters, CORS hardening (evil origin blocked; preview.emergentagent.com and booktalent.in regex allowed), 403 for non-admin, and Iter 86 regression. 22/22 pytest passed. Frontend AdminReports & AdminAudit UIs render with all expected data-testids; sub-tab switching, CSV buttons, filter apply/clear all functional.
critical_code_review_comments: reports.py manager-leads: docstring/spec says 12 stages but STAGES list has 13 items (includes both 'closed' and 'lost_cancelled' alongside 11 pipeline stages). Test adjusted; consider updating spec or removing one stage.
reports.py platform-waivers: platform_settings.find_one runs inside the async for-loop per booking (N+1 query). Move outside the loop for perf on large datasets.

reports.py unified audit: 'entity' filter is only applied to audit_logs source (q2), not admin_audit_log (q1 uses target_type). Consider matching target_type when entity filter is provided for admin source too.
reports.py CSV filename uses raw user-supplied start/end date strings — validate/whitelist to prevent header injection (unlikely due to regex on format param, but start/end are unvalidated).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter 87 fully green. CORS tested against http://localhost:8001 (preview ingress strips headers as noted). All 3 report endpoints & unified audit tested with all filter combos. Frontend testids confirmed: rep-tab-{revenue,artist-bookings,manager-leads,waivers}, rep-csv-{artist-bookings,manager-leads,waivers}, admin-audit, audit-filter-{actor,action,entity,start,end,apply,clear}.
